picks.file: Monasterium urbs in media Westphalia celeberrimi nominis... ; Osnabrugum elegans Saxoniae opp. ; Wesalia inferior - btv1b531789052 (1 of 2).jpg
picks.what: Engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 2
picks.why: colored skyline of Münster with the cathedral, Lamberti and Überwasser churches; trimmed to the top panel of the three-city plate

picks.what: View of the city before the siege of 1657, engraving
picks.why: ordinary skyline view from the upper panel; the siege panel below is trimmed away

gaps: P0: none; P3–P6: no candidates of Münster itself (hits are Ulm, Freiburg, Strasbourg, Bern and Basel minsters, Bad Münster am Stein, Lucerne); P6 street snapshots too weak
notes: #4 is a 1645 printing of the plate; the Münster view goes back to Remigius Hogenberg’s 1570 drawing (#2) and appeared in vol. 2 (1575) — please confirm the volume. #8 is the same Caspar Merian plate misdated 1654 (it shows the 1657 siege). The upper panel of #7 is a very wide strip (about 7:1), so the 16:9 crop shows only its center around the cathedral. #10 (Dancker Danckerts, dated only 1648–66) is a usable alternative for P2.
